mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM menu m INNER JOIN role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id and rm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_menu (role_id, menu_id, create_time) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{menuId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND menu_id = #{menuId}
